method: Automated inventory read every source, evidence, pathway, profile and review record in the exact manifest candidate for this ISO.

Automated screening compared source references, locators, geography fields, evidence class, direction, status, horizon and scenario; it checked pathway support IDs, link-evidence sets, geography fields, alternatives and uncertainty for follow-up.

Raw extraction access rows are recorded only as inherited access observations. This generated screen does not treat snippets, HTTP success, prior access, or metadata as claim verification and does not replace semantic source review.

source_refs.locator: Executive Summary, printed p. xii (PDF p. 14), climate-risk projections; chapter 1, printed p. 18 (PDF p. 22), rainfall baseline and uncertainty.

evidence.scenario: Multiple climate scenarios; the report describes both hotter/drier and warmer/wetter futures.
evidence.compact_statement: Prolonged dry spells and intense heavy rainfall are projected, but rainfall direction and magnitude remain uncertain; mean precipitation was 2,653.4 mm in 1991-2020.
recommendations: No wording change is indicated by the record-only check; keep the claim provisional until its cited passage is independently reopened.

source_refs.locator: Section 3.3, printed p. 30 (PDF p. 46), poverty impacts by climate scenario.

evidence.scenario: Baseline-growth, no-adaptation hot/dry and wet/warm climate scenarios.
evidence.compact_statement: Without adaptation, rural poverty is projected to rise 6.5-6.9 percentage points by 2050 under hot/dry or wet/warm scenarios, versus about 1.5 points in urban areas.
recommendations: No wording change is indicated by the record-only check; keep the claim provisional until its cited passage is independently reopened.

source_refs.locator: Section 3.3, printed p. 31 (PDF p. 47), district poverty results.

evidence.scenario: Hot/dry and wet/warm; baseline growth, no adaptation.
evidence.compact_statement: Climate change could erase Port Loko's poverty gains by about 12 points by 2050 under either case; Kambia and Bonthe also face wet/warm impacts.
recommendations: No wording change is indicated by the record-only check; keep the claim provisional until its cited passage is independently reopened.

source_refs.locator: Section 4.2, printed p. 79 (PDF p. 80), flood exposure of schools.

evidence.compact_statement: 372,000 children (11% of students) faced school-flood exposure; 10% of schools flooded repeatedly, and Bonthe had the highest district exposure and vulnerability.
recommendations: No wording change is indicated by the record-only check; keep the claim provisional until its cited passage is independently reopened.

source_refs.locator: Section 3.2.2, printed p. 28 (PDF p. 136), conflict-sensitive climate risks.

evidence.scenario: Qualitative NDC risk framing for fragile contexts; no quantified scenario is specified.
evidence.compact_statement: Sierra Leone’s NDC states that, in its post-conflict context, climate-related livelihood insecurity, resource competition, and migration can act as threat multipliers that heighten social-unrest or renewed-conflict risks, especially for youth and marginalized groups.
recommendations: No wording change is indicated by the record-only check; keep the claim provisional until its cited passage is independently reopened.

source_refs.locator: Section 3.2.2 and Table 50, printed p. 28 (PDF pp. 136-137), pastoralist-farmer risk pathway and response priorities.

evidence.scenario: Qualitative risk pathway; NDC table gives no quantified likelihood, place-specific forecast, or event date.
evidence.compact_statement: The NDC describes a risk in which drought and erratic rainfall may push herders beyond traditional grazing areas onto farmland, potentially triggering violent disputes over shrinking resources; its stated priorities include integrated land-use planning, formal land rights, migration corridors, and local mediation involving traditional leaders, youth, and women.
recommendations: No wording change is indicated by the record-only check; keep the claim provisional until its cited passage is independently reopened.
